m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wizard! What news from the Nepeta Mine? Thuggies, you say? Interesting. Qhatnip's effects are felt only in Qhats.
So that means they must have been hired by someone. What did you just say? It was the Grey Ghost's operation? Oh my.
The Grey Ghost is a mysterious underworld mastermind whose power extends far beyond that of any street gang or rival crime boss.
I suspected the prospect of adventure might be intriguing to you! There is something nefarious afoot in the desert, Wizard, I just know it!
I fear someone is trying to reinvigorate a long-ceased trade in an ancient and highly controversial spice called Qhatnip.
Qhatnip was once a delicacy amongst many in the Qhat nobility. However, other Qhats considered it disgusting and debasing.
Its use became so contentious that it spawned a bitter feud, known as the Great Qhat Fight. It was a bloodless fight. But, oh the drama!
Qhatnip was eventually outlawed, and every Qhatnip mine in Mirage was shuttered, but I've discovered one of them has been reopened!
It's the Nepeta Mine in the Rubal Wastes. Someone apparently plans to restart the Qhatnip trade, but we cannot allow it!
Please, my brave friend, go to the Nepeta Mine and shut it back down, before some crazy Qhat starts a war!
Someone has reopened the Nepeta Qhatnip Mine. You must stop them before they incite another feud amongst the Qhat families!
